borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Variation of condition 1 (Temporary permission) of planning permission ref: 2023/02600/VAR granted 19th December 2023 for the 'Variation of condition 1 (Temporary permission) of planning permission ref: 2022/03059/VAR granted 12th December 2022 for the 'Variation of condition 1 (Temporary permission) of planning permission ref: 2021/01130/FUL granted 8th June 2021 for the 'Use of land for the temporary siting of an 'Upside Down House' entertainment building and an 'Upside Down House' ticket office building for a period until 30th June 2022' to allow the continued use of the 'Upside Down House' entertainment building and an 'Upside Down House' ticket office building for a period until 1st December 2023', and allow the continued use of the 'Upside Down House' entertainment building and an 'Upside Down House' ticket office building for a period until 1st December 2025'. Allow the continued use of the 'Upside Down House' entertainment building and an 'Upside Down House' ticket office building for a period until 1st January 2028.
